transcript: Speaker A: Tumhari want aur need kya hai? [What is your want and need?] Speaker B: Aaj suraj kahan se ug gaya? Tum yahan mujhse pehle aa gayi. [Where did the sun rise from today? You came here before me.] Speaker A: Mera man hua toh aa gayi. [I felt like coming, so I came.] Speaker B: Good. Toh aaj hum kuchh naya sikhenge. Shekhar, ab board par likho. [Good. So today we will learn something new. Shekhar, now write on the board.] Speaker B: Yeh duniya teen words pe chalti hai. Pehla hai... [This world runs on three words. First is...] Speaker A: Want. Speaker B: Want. Hamein jo chahiye. [Want. What we want.] Speaker B: Dusra... [Second...] Speaker A: Need. Speaker B: Need. Jiski hamein zaroorat hai. [Need. What we need.] Speaker B: Aur teesra... [And third...] Speaker A: Have. Speaker B: Have. Woh jo hamare paas pehle se hai. Example ke taur pe... You have a smartphone. You need a copy. I want... [Have. What we already have. For example... You have a smartphone. You need a copy. I want...] Speaker A: Tum kal raat mere kamre mein aaye the. Apni jaan khatre mein daal ke tum mujhe bachane kyun aaye the? Tumhari want aur need kya hai? [You came to my room last night. Putting your life in danger, why did you come to save me? What is your want and need?] Speaker C: Kya hai Shekhar ki want aur need? Jawab janne ke liye kholo English Seekho app aur search karo Jasoos Teacher. Yeh bas drama nahi, seekhne ka mauka hai. Jo English is mission ki jaan thi, woh aap bhi seekho, usi app par. [What is Shekhar's want and need? To know the answer, open the English Seekho app and search for Jasoos Teacher. This is not just drama, it's an opportunity to learn. The English that was the soul of this mission, you learn it too, on the same app.] Speaker D: Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]

summary: The ad uses a dramatic cliffhanger from a romantic/mystery skit called 'Jasoos Teacher' to hook viewers. The characters discuss the English concepts of 'want', 'need', and 'have' before a dramatic confrontation. The voiceover encourages users to download the English Seekho app to watch the full story and learn English.
